ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white) and 25% low-intensity pixels (black) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) zones occupying the lateral lobes; central low-intensity (black) wedge-shaped blob extending from the peduncle to the median notch; distinct low-intensity (black) borders along the trailing edges and several isolated punctate low-intensity spots on the white interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; includes a prominent irregular indentation approximately mid-way on the left lobe and smaller, sharper peaks towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to narrow, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity, elevated circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically on the left lobe and diagonally on the right lobe, contrasting against the white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) on the inner white surfaces of both lobes; dense barnacle encrustation on the terminal ends.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' transition zone between the central black peduncle area and the white lobes, characterized by high-frequency pixel intensity fluctuation.
